principle: Source-first diagrams, separate semantic hit zones, review-gated publishing.

artifactContract.source: Original source, open source asset, or data/reference set with license and attribution.
artifactContract.plate: The visible unlabeled image used in the game.
artifactContract.overlay: Dots, polygons, or lines used for clicking. This is separate from the plate.
artifactContract.facts: Short prompts attached to targets. Facts remain blocked until reviewed.
artifactContract.review: Source, target placement, labels, aliases, and facts must be approved before publish.

preferredInputs: public domain or CC BY diagrams
house-style redraw from multiple anatomical references
blockedInputs: photographs unless the pack is explicitly photographic
anatomy.plateStrategy: clean unlabeled diagram, optionally house-style rendered

blockedInputs: text-to-image maps as factual base maps
geography.targetStrategy: data-derived polygons first, model only for naming and QA
geography.plateStrategy: render house-style map plates from source data

preferredInputs: public domain or CC BY science diagrams
blockedInputs: labeled diagrams without an unlabeled derivative path

preferredInputs: house-style original based on reviewed references
